scope: Existing installed Poaceae accepted names, synonyms, ranks and identity holds only; no species-card modifications

decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts this species in Poaceae; Peterson's 2010 combination is based on Lepturus paniculatus Nutt. Preserve the existing canonical species concept; do not install another card.
Basionym and homotypic synonym. Original epithet and Nuttall authorship verified against Peterson et al. 2010 and POWO.
Homotypic synonym of the same Nuttall type; no separate accepted species card.
Homotypic synonym under current POWO/WCVP. Historically accepted as Schedonnardus in Flora of North America 2003 and other floras; not a separate canonical species.
Homotypic synonym per POWO; author and genus transfer must be retained in historical crosswalk.
Heterotypic synonym per POWO, not a separate accepted Schedonnardus species in the current backbone. Its different type must not be silently treated as the Nuttall basionym.
Primary molecular phylogeny and formal new combination support including Schedonnardus within a monophyletic, expanded Muhlenbergia; accepted rank is species, not a hybrid or infraspecific taxon.

decisions.source_name: Proposed independent accepted learner card for Schedonnardus paniculatus
decisions.reason: Current POWO maps this exact homotypic combination to Muhlenbergia paniculata, which is already canonical in data/manifest.json. Do not install or reclassify it as a second accepted species.

decisions.source_name: Existing Matt Lavin source-labelled Schedonnardus paniculatus gallery photographs
decisions.reason: Correct synonymy establishes name equivalence but not species authentication of an individual photographed plant; existing gallery remains provisional pending voucher/anatomical review by the photo lane. No media or arrow edits.

decisions.source_name: Hybrid ancestry of photographed Muhlenbergia paniculata specimens
decisions.reason: Neither the current accepted species treatment nor the reviewed source photographs establish a named hybrid for this card; preserve any individual-specimen uncertainty and do not infer parentage from the transfer from Schedonnardus.

decisions.source_name: Historical records under accepted genus Schedonnardus in older authorities
decisions.reason: Flora of North America (2003) and other older sources treated Schedonnardus as a separate genus; current POWO follows Peterson et al. (2010). The current accepted mapping is PASS, but unvouchered historical identifications under the old genus are not independently verified.

decisions.source_name: Authorless or incomplete historical Schedonnardus texanus specimen labels
decisions.reason: The published Steudel name maps to Muhlenbergia paniculata in POWO, but incomplete source labels or misapplied determinations cannot be validated without a voucher, original determination and date; no blanket specimen reassignment.

limitations: No photographic specimen-level identity or hybrid ancestry established by nomenclatural synonymy.
Alternative historical Schedonnardus genus usage is recorded, not promoted as a second accepted species.
No county nativity audit, media, learner card, lessons, installation, Pages or unrelated taxa changes.
